rationale: Both candidates largely miss the ground-truth P1s (Cache-DiT/second-DiT gap, modular alias metadata, Ref2VA implicit task default, Qwen3-TTS validation, SamitHuang's style comments) — X lands closest with a well-diagnosed Qwen3-TTS arch-string mismatch, but neither otherwise overlaps GT concerns, so recall is low for both. Both substitute independently-discovered, well-evidenced findings (line-cited, some with repro output/test runs) rather than fabrication, giving decent precision and strong actionability. Y edges ahead on precision via better-calibrated severity tiering (Blocking/Should-fix/Worth-considering, explicit 'latent, not yet firing' hedging) and concrete reproduction evidence for its top claims.
